---
title: "Component image"
video:
  width: 1920
  height: 1080
  fps: 30
---

Each scene holds one image: a portrait, a landscape and an extreme 1:4
picture, each with fit cover and fit contain, and one SVG without a caption.

::: {.scene component="image" duration="2s"}
::: {.image src="assets/portrait.png" fit="cover" alt="A blue to amber gradient, portrait"}
:::

::: {.caption}
Portrait, cover: the picture fills the frame and is cropped.
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="image" duration="2s"}
::: {.image src="assets/portrait.png" fit="contain" alt="A blue to amber gradient, portrait"}
:::

::: {.caption}
Portrait, contain: the whole picture shows inside the frame.
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="image" duration="2s"}
::: {.image src="assets/landscape.jpg" fit="cover" alt="A teal to rose gradient, landscape"}
:::

::: {.caption}
Landscape, cover.
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="image" duration="2s"}
::: {.image src="assets/landscape.jpg" fit="contain" alt="A teal to rose gradient, landscape"}
:::

::: {.caption}
Landscape, contain.
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="image" duration="2s"}
::: {.image src="assets/tall.webp" fit="cover" alt="A violet to green gradient, extreme 1 to 4"}
:::

::: {.caption}
Extreme 1:4, cover.
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="image" duration="2s"}
::: {.image src="assets/tall.webp" fit="contain" alt="A violet to green gradient, extreme 1 to 4"}
:::

::: {.caption}
Extreme 1:4, contain.
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="image" duration="2s"}
::: {.image src="assets/diagram.svg" fit="contain" alt="A blue circle and an amber square"}
:::
